Response nextMatchAt drives the minutesUntilNext calculation.
The interval repeatedly invokes fetchStatus, which calls the live status endpoint.
Effect cleanup clears completion timeout, unsubscribes, removes listeners, and disconnects.
Hook registers connect and disconnect handlers and updates isConnected.
Hook registers a match:status socket handler.
Hook registers a score:update socket handler.
Hook registers scoreflow:add handler with dedupe logic.
Hook calls io with /api/socketio path and reconnection options.
Hook registers stat:event handler.

socketRef stores TypedSocket derived from Socket event types.
Matching match:status payloads set state.matchStatus.
Matching score:update payloads set state.score.
Deduped score flow payloads append to state.scoreFlow.
Matching stat:event payloads append to state.statEvents.
Matching stats:update payloads set state.playerStats.
Connect handler emits match:subscribe and cleanup emits match:unsubscribe.
COMPLETED status schedules reconnection disable and socket disconnect after 2000 ms.
Standings tests require excludeSimData round not 99, which explicitly separates real completed matches from simulation round 99 records.
Required Match, Team, Player, ScoreFlow, and PollLog models are the persistence targets for Champion Data fixture and match-stat structures.
Raw and normalized match stats types model the same Champion Data endpoint with different wrapper and field names.
Momentum bars can be derived from accumulated scoring events by quarter, though the prototype hard-codes widths.
Socket score-flow events expose period, seconds, scores, scoring team, and score points derived from the same scoring event concept.
Defensive impact displays turnovers created and clean intercepts, both part of team defensive stat semantics.
Team efficiency summarizes shooting accuracy, which derives from team goals and attempts.
Optional raw player stat fields normalize into the required CDPlayerStats shape used downstream.
MVP card highlights a player's goals and rebounds, fields present in Champion Data player stats.
Columns for goals, shots, assists-adjacent feeding, intercepts, deflections, rebounds, and shooting percentage are sourced from player stat data.
PlayerStatRow extends stat values used to render box scores while Champion Data player stats supply those values.
Hero summary displays home and away score and live-match status matching score:update payload semantics.
Both structures carry per-player live stat values including goals, attempts, assists, defensive stats, and minutes.
Live-state discovery and match status socket payloads both classify live and scheduled match lifecycle states, but no direct call is shown in this chunk.
The score-flow delta rows contain the same fields carried by scoreflow:add socket payloads.
The prototype's player rows render the same id/name/position/stat-row idea defined by PlayerStatRow, across HTML and TypeScript.
The quarter-by-quarter momentum bars are a visual version of per-quarter home/away score proportions.
TheSportsDB team payload contains badge, team name, country, and display media later reducible to shared team display info.
The tests assert broadcastScoreFlowDelta causes broadcastScoreFlowAdd calls for newly discovered score-flow rows.
Mocks and expectations show ingestion invokes fetchFixture before evaluating match details.
Tests assert playing, complete, and backfill cases call fetchMatchStats with competition and match IDs.
The sidebar's active match count and Live Pulse label align with live-state discovery but no direct code link is shown.
The mobile bottom nav re-expresses top/side navigation destinations as a compact responsive navigation pattern.
